# index.html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pixel & Code — Web & App Development</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  :root{
    --ink: #12151C;
    --ink-soft: #1B1F29;
    --paper: #F5F3ED;
    --amber: #FFB238;
    --cyan: #4FD1C5;
    --muted: #8B8FA3;
    --muted-light: #B9BCCB;
    --step: 10px;
  }

  *{ margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }

  html{ scroll-behavior:smooth; }

  body{
    background:var(--ink);
    color:var(--paper);
    font-family:'Inter', sans-serif;
    line-height:1.5;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }

  ::selection{ background:var(--amber); color:var(--ink); }

  a{ color:inherit; }

  .mono{ font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }

  :focus-visible{
    outline: 2px solid var(--cyan);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  /* ---------- Layout shell ---------- */
  .wrap{
    max-width: 1180px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 32px;
  }

  section{ position:relative; }

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  nav{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background:rgba(18,21,28,0.9);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }
  nav .wrap{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding-top:18px; padding-bottom:18px;
  }
  .brand{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:17px;
    letter-spacing:-0.02em;
  }
  .brand span:first-child{ color:var(--amber); }
  .brand span:last-child{ color:var(--cyan); }
  .brand .sep{ color:var(--muted); padding:0 2px; }

  nav ul{
    list-style:none;
    display:flex;
    gap:32px;
    font-size:14px;
    color:var(--muted-light);
  }
  nav ul a{ text-decoration:none; transition: color .2s; }
  nav ul a:hover{ color:var(--paper); }
  nav ul{ display:none; }
  @media(min-width:720px){ nav ul{ display:flex; } }

  .nav-cta{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:600;
    background:var(--amber);
    color:var(--ink);
    padding:9px 16px;
    border-radius:3px;
    text-decoration:none;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }

  /* ---------- Stepped pixel divider (signature element) ---------- */
  .pixel-divider{
    height: 18px;
    width:100%;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(90deg, var(--amber) 50%, var(--cyan) 50%);
    background-size: var(--step) 100%;
    clip-path: polygon(
      0 0, 10% 0, 10% 50%, 20% 50%, 20% 0, 30% 0, 30% 50%, 40% 50%, 40% 0,
      50% 0, 50% 50%, 60% 50%, 60% 0, 70% 0, 70% 50%, 80% 50%, 80% 0,
      90% 0, 90% 50%, 100% 50%, 100% 100%, 0 100%
    );
    opacity:0.9;
  }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    min-height: 640px;
    position:relative;
    background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18,21,28,0.55), rgba(18,21,28,0.88)), url('data:image/jpeg;base64,
